name: issuetrack
description: IssueTrack — a production-ready MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) Jira-style issue and bug tracker

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix server && npm run format --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
